title: Lost Mary BM600 Triple Berry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Triple Berry Ice Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods deliver a cool take on a three-berry blend. Sweet Blueberry, sharp Raspberry, and juicy Strawberry are layered together, rounded off with a brisk icy finish for a refreshing edge. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, giving up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. With their smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, these pods are simple, satisfying, and hassle-free. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and clean: click a pod into place and enjoy a crisp fruit-and-ice flavour that lasts.
